column1: # scripts/deadlines.tsv: the wall-clock budget of every step that runs under scripts/deadline,
# in whole seconds. One row a step: step<TAB>seconds<TAB>basis. A step ending in * is a family:
# the budget of every step that starts so and has no row of its own (the longest prefix wins).
# FPL_DEADLINE_<STEP> overrides a row for one run (scripts/deadline names the variable).
# The basis says where the number comes from: "measured" names the wall time seen and the date,
# and the budget is 3-5x that; "prior" is a guess no measurement has replaced yet. CI jobs are
# bounded by timeout-minutes in .github/workflows/, which cannot read this file.
